issue.title: test_grouping_cycle_palette_commands_follow_grouping_capability fails under just check, passes in isolation
issue.description: Discovered while running 'just check' after an unrelated tests/test_axe_cli.py split (no axe_cli references in the failing test file). The scoped run reported '1 failed, 42393 passed, 14 skipped' with the sole failure at tests/test_command_availability_scope.py::test_grouping_cycle_palette_commands_follow_grouping_capability. Re-running that node ID alone with 'pytest tests/test_command_availability_scope.py::test_grouping_cycle_palette_commands_follow_grouping_capability -q' passed cleanly on the same, unchanged tree. No investigation into root cause was done beyond confirming isolation reproduces green; likely test-order/state pollution from another module in the full suite run.

task_type_fields.evidence: Full 'just check' run: 1 failed, 42393 passed, 14 skipped -- the single failure was this test. Immediately re-ran the same node ID alone (no tree changes in between) and it passed in 1 run. Only one data point so far in each direction; have not yet bisected which other test(s) pollute state to trigger the failure.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just check (full scoped run); isolated rerun: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_command_availability_scope.py::test_grouping_cycle_palette_commands_follow_grouping_capability -q
